taste.cabernet: Structured and firm with blackcurrant and oak — pairs with red meat.
taste.chardonnay: Round and a little creamy with stone fruit and a touch of vanilla.
taste.do: A red wine: ripe fruit with some grip — good with meat and grills.
taste.grenache: Round and juicy with red fruit and a hint of spice.
taste.merlot: Soft and plummy with ripe cherry — an easy first red.
taste.pinot-gris: Light and smooth with pear and green apple.
taste.pinot-noir: Light and elegant with red cherry and berry, gentle tannin.
taste.port: Rich and sweet with dried fruit and nuts — a dessert pour.
taste.riesling: Delicate and bright with citrus and white blossom.
taste.rose: Light and fresh with strawberry and red fruit — lovely served chilled.
taste.sauvignon-blanc: Crisp and zesty with lime and tropical fruit.
taste.shiraz: Bold and warm with ripe plum and black pepper.
taste.sparkling: Fresh and lightly sparkling, green apple and citrus — made for aperitifs and parties.
taste.trang: A white wine: fresh and light, served chilled — good with seafood.
